scripts.db:dev:reset: docker compose stop postgres-dev && docker compose rm -f -v postgres-dev && docker compose up --wait postgres-dev
scripts.local:setup: pnpm local:check-env && pnpm env:dev && pnpm db:dev:up && pnpm prisma:dev:generate && pnpm prisma:dev:migrate
scripts.prisma:dev:migrate: node scripts/run-prisma-with-profile.mjs dev -- migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:dev:reset: node scripts/run-prisma-with-profile.mjs dev -- migrate reset --schema prisma/schema.prisma --force
scripts.prisma:personal:migrate: node scripts/run-prisma-with-profile.mjs personal -- migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
